pictures.title: GRC-1998-C-00485
pictures.caption: Comparison of a Candle Flame burning in normal gravity or 1-G (left) and a flame burning in Microgravity.
pictures.source: NASA Image and Video Library, GRC-1998-C-00485
pictures.alt: Two candle flames side by side on black: a tall yellow teardrop flame on the left, a small round blue flame on the right.
pictures.edit: Cropped: the white frame with the NASA insignia and the centre name is removed.

pictures.title: Pettit performs a session of BASS Fire Safety Tests at the MSG
pictures.caption: NASA astronaut Don Pettit, Expedition 30 flight engineer, performs a session of Burning and Suppression of Solids (BASS) fire safety tests at the Microgravity Sciences Glovebox (MSG)
pictures.source: NASA Image and Video Library, iss030e178648
pictures.alt: An astronaut in a black shirt reaches with both arms into a glovebox on the space station, surrounded by cameras and cables.

pictures.title: BASS-II Experiment
pictures.caption: Image taken on card 8 during BASS-II flame test session with reduced O2 partial pressure.
pictures.source: NASA Image and Video Library, iss040e086481
pictures.alt: A thin blue flame curves around the glowing tip of a dark rod against a black background.
